description: This file contains the implementation of the PooledBufferStream class, a custom Stream that uses object pooling and buffer segments for efficient memory management and sequence operations within the Orleans.Serialization.Buffers.Adaptors namespace.

classes.name: PooledBufferStream
classes.description: A stream implementation that uses pooled buffers and supports sequence operations, including reading, writing, seeking, and resetting.

classes.name: BufferSegment
classes.description: A nested internal class representing segments of buffers used in ReadOnlySequence, also pooled for reuse.

methods.name: Rent
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of PooledBufferStream from the object pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns a PooledBufferStream instance back to the object pool for reuse.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Returns the written content as a byte array.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the contents to a provided IBufferWriter.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream, returning buffers to the pool and clearing internal state.

methods.name: RentReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Creates and returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> over the written buffers; must be returned via ReturnReadOnlySequence.

methods.name: ReturnReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns the buffers used in a ReadOnlySequence back to the pool.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Moves the current position within the stream based on offset and origin.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the current position into a buffer.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Adjusts the length of the stream, either truncating or extending.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the stream at the current position.
